No reference to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets is provided. No service type specification (single-phase vs. three-phase) is documented. The submission does not include AE Design pad detail drawings matching the proposed equipment.
agentTrace.reasoning: UCM § 1.5.2.6 and § 1.18.0 require that transformer pad dimensions match Austin Energy Design-approved detail sheets specific to the service type. The submitted electrical plan shows transformer pad locations only, with no detailed dimensions or reference to AE Design detail sheets. This is a required submission element that is missing from the plans.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.18.0 (obtain transformer pad detail from AE Design)
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations shown on Sheet 21
findings.comment: Transformer pad detail sheets matching Austin Energy Design specifications are not provided. Submit AE Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for each pad showing: (1) service type (single-phase or three-phase), (2) pad dimensions (width x depth), (3) equipment specifications, and (4) any special installation requirements per UCM § 1.5.2.6.

agentTrace.observation: Sheet 9 (Site Plan) shows parking layout with driveways and parking areas. Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan) shows four transformer pad locations. Vision analysis identified that two pads (between Bldgs 5 & 6 and near Bldg 7) have four small circles marked, suggesting bollards. However, no dimension callouts show whether these pads are within 4 feet of parking areas, and no bollard specifications (4-inch diameter, galvanized, rigid metal, spacing for door opening) are provided.
agentTrace.reasoning: While bollards appear to be shown on two pads, verification that they meet the 4-inch minimum diameter specification per AE Design equipment pad details cannot be made without explicit specifications. Additionally, whether the other two pads are within 4 feet of parking/vehicle circulation areas cannot be determined without dimension callouts. The grouping notes that bollards must be spaced to allow equipment door opening, which is not documented.

applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations relative to parking areas, drive aisles, and vehicle circulation on Sheets 9 and 21
findings.comment: Bollard specifications and clearance determinations are not provided. For all transformer pads within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle circulation routes, submit: (1) dimension callouts confirming distances to parking/circulation areas, and (2) bollard detail sheets showing 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts with spacing that allows equipment access door opening per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.

agentTrace.observation: The site plan (Sheets 9, 21) shows underground electrical service with pad-mounted transformers. No overhead distribution facilities are depicted on any site plan sheet. No poles or aerial conductors are shown.
agentTrace.reasoning: This item applies only when overhead distribution facilities exist on the property. The submitted site plan shows underground electrical service exclusively. No customer facilities (buildings, parking garages, light poles, signs, billboards, chimneys, antennas, tanks) are proposed to be installed under or over non-existent overhead distribution facilities.

applicableAreas: Only applicable if overhead distribution facilities are present (not shown on site)
